title: NBI probes pet crematorium after 29 animals dumped in Bulacan

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) will conduct a comprehensive investigation into incidents involving Ahjay Paws Aftercare Pet Crematorium in Bacoor City, Cavite, following the discovery of 29 deceased dogs and cats allegedly dumped at a vacant lot in San Jose del Monte, Bulacan, NBI Director Melvin Matibag said Monday. The 29 dead animals, packed into several large sacks, were reportedly dumped at the vacant lot in Barangay Minuyan Proper early Thursday morning, October 29, by still unidentified individuals riding a white van.
